SEO

SEO Basics Every Freelancer Should Know

Why SEO Matters for Freelancers

When potential clients search for services you offer, you want your portfolio to appear. SEO isn't about tricking search engines - it's about making your work discoverable to the right people.

Start with Keyword Research

Think about what your ideal client types into Google. If you're a digital marketer in Haryana, they might search "digital marketing freelancer Haryana" or "SEO services near me." Use free tools like Google Keyword Planner or Ubersuggest to find relevant terms with decent search volume.

On-Page Basics

Each page needs a clear title tag (under 60 characters), a meta description (150-160 characters), and one H1 heading that includes your primary keyword. Use descriptive alt text for images. Structure content with H2 and H3 headings - this helps both readers and search engines understand your page hierarchy.

Technical Foundation

Make sure your site loads fast, works on mobile, and has a clean URL structure. Submit your sitemap to Google Search Console. Fix any crawl errors. These technical basics often matter more than clever content tricks.

Content That Ranks

Write for humans first. Answer real questions your clients have. A case study showing how you helped a local business increase traffic by 40% is more valuable than a generic "5 SEO tips" post. Include specific results, tools used, and lessons learned.

Build Trust Signals

Get client testimonials with permission to use their name and company. Link to live projects. Add schema markup for your Person and WebSite types. These signals tell Google you're a legitimate professional, not a spam site.
